important_scope_controls: ICCR has 18 named 2026/27 schemes; 18 schemes do not mean 18 publishable 2027 programmes.
CUHK-Shenzhen entry scholarship tiers are variants within one umbrella, not automatically five separate scholarship records.
UKM 2020 and 2021 documents disagree on Master's eligibility; do not silently pick older or newer terms as current.
UMSS includes conditional repayment on breach; not a conventional unconditional scholarship.
IIT Bombay AARDO is tuition waiver only, not full scholarship; foreign TA is an assistantship.
Official CUHK 2027 English-document deadline discrepancy (May 21 vs May 28) is unresolved.
No 2027 deadlines inferred from 2026 historical calls; no transient HTTP failure treated as programme closure.
